name: Ash
source: Ash's looks resemble his mother's, but as for personality, he took after his father. He hates being judged by his appearance. As expected, he's very popular with girls, which is the reason why his classmates have frequently accused him of being a Casanova. He has always thought that since birth, fate has chosen for him a path of misfortune.
